name: Flammable Atmosphere Response
steps: Evacuate all personnel from affected zone immediately
Isolate gas and fuel supply lines to the zone
Prohibit hot work and ignition sources within 50m
Ventilate area only if gas concentration is confirmed dropping
Notify fire response and plant emergency coordinator

name: Mechanical Equipment Shutdown
steps: Initiate controlled shutdown of affected equipment
Lock out / tag out energy sources before maintenance re-entry
Allow cooldown period per equipment procedure
Inspect bearings, coupling, and lubrication systems
Document vibration and temperature trend before restart

name: Chemical Exposure Containment
steps: Evacuate non-essential personnel from zone
Verify full PPE compliance before any re-entry
Contain spill or leak source if safe to do so
Activate decontamination station at zone boundary
Notify HSE officer and medical standby

name: Electrical Isolation
steps: De-energize affected circuits at source breaker
Apply lockout/tagout per site electrical safety procedure
Test for zero energy before work resumes
Restrict access to arc-flash boundary
Only qualified electricians may re-energize

name: Confined Space Emergency
steps: Do not enter confined space without attendant and gas monitor
Continuously monitor O2, LEL, and toxic gas levels
Activate rescue team — no solo rescue attempts
Ventilate space per confined space entry permit
Suspend all hot work in adjacent zones

name: Plant-Wide Evacuation
steps: Sound plant-wide evacuation alarm
Account for all personnel at muster points
Shut down non-essential processes per emergency SOP
Establish exclusion zone until all-clear from incident commander
Preserve sensor and CCTV logs for investigation
